images.request_prompt: Key art for a game of Rick Riordan's The Lightning Thief. The three heroes stand on Half-Blood Hill at golden hour beside a tall, lone pine tree, looking out toward a distant ornamental New York skyline and a stormy sky crackling with stylised lightning bolts. Percy Jackson, twelve, son of Poseidon: slim, messy jet-black hair, sea-green eyes, a lopsided troublemaker grin; orange Camp Half-Blood T-shirt (a small black pegasus emblem), faded jeans, worn sneakers; Riptide, a leaf-shaped celestial-bronze sword that turns into a ballpoint pen when capped; Annabeth Chase, twelve, daughter of Athena: athletic, tanned, curly honey-blonde hair in a high ponytail, sharp storm-grey eyes, a confident, calculating look; orange Camp Half-Blood T-shirt, shorts, a clay-bead camp necklace, a bronze dagger at her belt and a navy New York Yankees-style baseball cap (no logo) that makes her invisible; Grover Underwood, a satyr who looks about twelve: lanky, curly brown hair hiding two small horns, a wispy goatee, kind nervous eyes; in disguise a cap, a T-shirt, baggy jeans over furry goat legs and oversized fake sneakers; carries reed pipes and nibbles a tin can. Percy holds Riptide drawn, Annabeth points the way, Grover clutches his pipes. The scene sits inside a black-and-gold ornamental frame of Greek-key borders with small emblems in the corners (a trident, an owl, a lightning bolt, a pan pipe) and an empty cartouche at the top for the title. Cartoon heroes in an ornamental world: the characters are drawn in a clean, bright cartoon style (ink outlines, flat cel-shaded colour, expressive faces) and stand in front of a world painted as flat decorative illustration: layered patterned shapes, waves, clouds and smoke drawn as curling ornamental ribbons, Greek-key and wave-scroll borders, black-figure and red-figure vase motifs, fine gold-leaf linework on deep teal, navy and black grounds, a subtle paper grain. Modern places (New York, highways, Las Vegas) get the same ornamental treatment, so that skyscrapers and neon look as if painted on an ancient vase. Exciting rather than frightening: monsters are bold and dramatic, never gory. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.

The gates of the Underworld: a vast cavern under Los Angeles, the River Styx a black ribbon full of drifting lost things, a skeletal ferryman's boat, and the Fields of Asphodel stretching off as endless grey wheat under a ceiling of stalactites. The gigantic three-headed Cerberus looms over the gate; Annabeth Chase, twelve, daughter of Athena: athletic, tanned, curly honey-blonde hair in a high ponytail, sharp storm-grey eyes, a confident, calculating look; orange Camp Half-Blood T-shirt, shorts, a clay-bead camp necklace, a bronze dagger at her belt and a navy New York Yankees-style baseball cap (no logo) that makes her invisible distracts him by throwing a big red rubber ball while Percy Jackson, twelve, son of Poseidon: slim, messy jet-black hair, sea-green eyes, a lopsided troublemaker grin; orange Camp Half-Blood T-shirt (a small black pegasus emblem), faded jeans, worn sneakers; Riptide, a leaf-shaped celestial-bronze sword that turns into a ballpoint pen when capped and Grover Underwood, a satyr who looks about twelve: lanky, curly brown hair hiding two small horns, a wispy goatee, kind nervous eyes; in disguise a cap, a T-shirt, baggy jeans over furry goat legs and oversized fake sneakers; carries reed pipes and nibbles a tin can sneak past. Far off, the black palace of Hades with bronze gates and gardens of glowing jewel-fruit. Grey, violet and black ground with gold linework and a single warm glow from the ball. Cartoon heroes in an ornamental world: the characters are drawn in a clean, bright cartoon style (ink outlines, flat cel-shaded colour, expressive faces) and stand in front of a world painted as flat decorative illustration: layered patterned shapes, waves, clouds and smoke drawn as curling ornamental ribbons, Greek-key and wave-scroll borders, black-figure and red-figure vase motifs, fine gold-leaf linework on deep teal, navy and black grounds, a subtle paper grain. Modern places (New York, highways, Las Vegas) get the same ornamental treatment, so that skyscrapers and neon look as if painted on an ancient vase. Exciting rather than frightening: monsters are bold and dramatic, never gory. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
Landscape PNG, 2560 × 1440 pixels.

images.request_prompt: A game interface concept sheet. Across the top, three tall character-select cards, each an ornate black-and-gold frame built from its hero's parent emblems: Percy's with tridents, waves and hippocampi; Annabeth's with owls, olive branches and a compass; Grover's with pan pipes, vines and tin cans. Inside each card the hero in a dynamic cartoon pose. Below, an interface kit on deep navy: a health bar as a wave-scroll band, a power meter shaped like a lightning bolt, round ability icons in gold vase-style roundels (water surge, invisibility cap, pipes song, shield, golden drachma, ambrosia square, nectar cup), dialogue-box frames with Greek-key borders, and buttons.
